payload.title: Model download seems stuck
payload.body: Large models (4GB+) take time. Check your network speed in the download bar. If speed drops to 0, HuggingFace might be throttling — wait a minute and it'll resume.

payload.title: Model won't load (out of memory)
payload.body: Your GPU doesn't have enough VRAM for this model. Try a smaller quantization (Q4 instead of Q8) or use CPU mode (slower but works with any RAM).

payload.title: Chat not responding
payload.body: The brain model might not be loaded. Open Model Loader and check if the Brain card shows 'Active'. If it shows 'Not Loaded', click the load button.

payload.title: App feels slow on startup
payload.body: First boot initializes databases and scans for models. Subsequent starts are much faster because everything is cached. Give it 10-15 seconds on first run.

payload.title: Wrong model in the picker
payload.body: ModelPicker filters by capability. If a model doesn't appear where you expect, check its devpulse.json — the 'capabilities' array controls which slots it's compatible with.
